source: DR 08 T4-3 — PF-RPF12-001, independent of the aggregate cap
_source: **Expected: ₹30,000 added to salary, with `PF-AGGCAP-001` contributing nothing.** "PF-AGGCAP-001: aggregate 1,50,000 ≤ 7,50,000 → no excess = 0". Only that nil is asserted here; the ₹30,000 (PF-RPF12-001) is W-074b's (after W-073c). No excess, so no fund history is needed.
